rules.statement: Section 615 of the Civil Procedure Code does not provide a husband with the right to apply for modification of an order for monthly payment of alimony when such an order is secured by the hypothecation of property.
rules.supporting_quote: "Section 615 of the Civil Procedure Code gives no right to a husband to apply for the modification of an order for the monthly payment of alimony when the order is accompanied by a direction that the payment should be secured by the hypothecation of property."
